integrity: Exact coefficient identities and global rational Fourier positivity proof; code is a reproducibility supplement and is not treated as a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: An exact separating profile, not a characterization of all hexagon-radial positive functions. Bounded literature comparison, with the 1997 original available in abstract only. Independent validation not performed.
title: A positive-definite hexagonal radial function outside the square-radial Schoenberg class
